Name: Nahor, Brother of Abraham
Summary: Nahor was a son of Terah and the brother of Abraham and Haran. He married Milcah, the daughter of his brother Haran.
KeyStory: Nahor stayed in the family's homeland while Abraham journeyed to Canaan; his children through Milcah and Reumah became the family Abraham later turned to for Isaac's wife.
LifeLesson: God works through the family members who stay as well as those who go.
